title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree Commentaries And The Risale I Nur As Signatures To Its Miraculousness

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The passage says that the Qur’an has had lasting honor, influence, and reward because of its special qualities.

questions.question: For about how long does the passage say the Qur’an’s shining rule has continued?
questions.answer: For about one thousand three hundred years.

questions.question: What has the Qur’an been illuminating during that long time?
questions.answer: It has been lighting up the centuries and the earth.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does each letter of the Qur’an earn at minimum?
questions.answer: At least ten rewards, ten merits, and ten everlasting fruits.

questions.question: How are some verses and suras described as different from ordinary letters in reward?
questions.answer: Their letters can bring a hundred or a thousand rewards, or even more.

questions.question: What happens to the reward and value of letters during blessed times?
questions.answer: They increase from ten to hundreds.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect these rewards to the Qur’an’s qualities?
questions.answer: It means the greatness of the Qur’an is the reason its letters carry such special blessings.

questions.question: What did the traveler do after understanding this?
questions.answer: He turned inward and spoke to his own heart.

questions.question: What does the passage say comes from the six points, aspects, and levels mentioned earlier?
questions.answer: They lead to the Qur’an’s noble and powerful authority.

questions.question: How is that authority described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as lofty, bright, holy, and mighty.

questions.question: What does the long-lasting nature of this authority suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that the Qur’an’s message is not temporary but enduring.

questions.question: Over what two large areas is the Qur’an’s influence described?
questions.answer: Over the centuries and across the earth.

questions.question: What special honor is given to each letter of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Each letter is given a sacred rank because of the rewards attached to it.

questions.question: Name two kinds of benefits the passage links to each letter.
questions.answer: Merits and eternal fruits.

questions.question: How does the passage show that not all rewards are exactly the same?
questions.answer: It says some letters receive more reward in certain verses, suras, and blessed times.

questions.question: What does the phrase about eternal fruits suggest about the Hereafter?
questions.answer: It suggests that the benefits of reciting the Qur’an continue beyond this worldly life.

questions.question: How does the ending of the passage change from description to personal reflection?
questions.answer: It moves from explaining the Qur’an’s excellence to the traveler’s inner response.

questions.question: According to the passage, why has the Qur’an’s sacred rule lasted so long?
questions.answer: Because of its special qualities and characteristics.

questions.question: What number is repeated to organize those qualities?
questions.answer: The number six.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an’s rule described in relation to beauty and strength?
questions.answer: It is shown as both shining and powerful.

questions.question: What is the smallest reward mentioned for one letter?
questions.answer: Ten rewards.

questions.question: What larger amounts can some letters bring?
questions.answer: One hundred, one thousand, or even more.

questions.question: Does the passage speak only about worldly benefit from the Qur’an?
questions.answer: No, it also speaks about lasting benefit in the next life.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about even the smallest part of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Even a single letter has great worth.

questions.question: What has continued with full brightness for centuries according to the passage?
questions.answer: The Qur’an’s exalted and holy authority.

questions.question: What two images are used to show the reach of that brightness?
questions.answer: The faces of the centuries and the face of the earth.

questions.question: What causes the Qur’an’s lasting greatness in this passage?
questions.answer: Its qualities and characteristics.

questions.question: What does the passage say every letter receives as a special distinction?
questions.answer: A holy honor of producing many rewards and lasting benefits.

questions.question: How many rewards are promised at the lowest level?
questions.answer: Ten.

questions.question: In what cases does the reward become much greater?
questions.answer: In certain verses, certain suras, and blessed times.

questions.question: How would you summarize the passage’s view of the Qur’an in one sentence?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is so عظیم and blessed that its authority lasts through history and even its letters bring great reward.

questions.question: What immediate result did this understanding have on the traveler?
questions.answer: It led him to reflect deeply within himself.

questions.question: What does the passage connect to the Qur’an’s continuing glory over many centuries?
questions.answer: The passage connects it to the Qur’an’s many special qualities.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Qur’an’s rule or authority?
questions.answer: As noble, radiant, sacred, and strong.

questions.question: For how many years does the passage say this has lasted?
questions.answer: About thirteen hundred years.

questions.question: Besides lasting a long time, what has this authority been doing?
questions.answer: It has been giving light to history and to the earth.

questions.question: What basic reward comes from each individual letter?
questions.answer: Each letter brings at least ten rewards and other lasting benefits.

questions.question: What does the passage say about letters in some special parts of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They can bring far more reward than the basic amount.

questions.question: What happens to the value of these letters in blessed times?
questions.answer: Their reward rises greatly, reaching into the hundreds.

questions.question: Why is mentioning a single letter important for understanding the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that every part of the Qur’an is precious, even the smallest part.

questions.question: How did the traveler respond after he understood these truths?
questions.answer: He spoke to his heart, showing personal reflection and readiness to go deeper.

questions.question: What is one reason the passage gives for the Qur’an’s ongoing influence?
questions.answer: Its many strong qualities and levels of excellence.

questions.question: What words in the passage show that the Qur’an’s authority is both spiritual and majestic?
questions.answer: It is described as elevated, luminous, holy, and mighty.

questions.question: How broad is the Qur’an’s impact according to the passage?
questions.answer: It stretches across long ages and over the earth.

questions.question: What reward is attached to every letter of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: At least ten rewards, along with merits and everlasting fruits.

questions.question: How does the passage distinguish some letters from others?
questions.answer: Letters in certain verses and suras are said to bring much greater reward.

questions.question: What role do blessed times play in the reward of recitation?
questions.answer: They increase the light, value, and reward of each letter.

questions.question: What does the word everlasting suggest about these fruits?
questions.answer: It suggests they remain in the Hereafter and do not end.

questions.question: What does the traveler’s final reaction show about proper learning?
questions.answer: Proper learning should lead to sincere self-reflection and a living connection with the heart.
